facebook.caption:
4.9 stars. 1,820 reviews. At a café in Duong Dong.

CAFE GREEN(카페그린) on Trần Hưng Đạo is not playing around. The mango bingsu alone justifies the visit. Cold, loaded, and built for Phu Quoc heat.

Pricing sits at $15-30 per person. Worth every cent for the quality.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
